name: open-self-learning-plugin
description: Portable self-learning harness for Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes with built-in CodeGraph MCP support for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Portable self-learning harness with CodeGraph support
interface.longDescription: selfL provides a portable engineering profile and staged self-learning workflows for Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes. It keeps user and project experience under ~/.selfl, avoids overwriting host memory by default, and registers CodeGraph in Codex for repository exploration, call-flow tracing, and impact analysis.
